lines.en: label beachsevenrin1:
scene sky
Oh, hello there. I must have forgotten you were watching.
lines.zh: 哦，你好啊。我大概忘了你还在看着。

lines.en: And while I’m sure my thoughts were sorely missed, I’ve been struggling to get them in order over the last few hours. So it’s like I never had much to share in the first place.
lines.zh: 虽然我确信我的思绪一定被万分想念，但过去这几个小时里我一直理不清它们，所以就像我从一开始也没什么可分享的一样。

lines.en: There are two things worth mentioning, though.
lines.zh: 不过有两件事值得一提。

lines.en: One — I had sex with Wakana and it was awesome. But it seems that she does not agree as she has apparently vanished from the beach and will not answer my texts.
lines.zh: 一——我和 Wakana 上床了，而且爽翻了。但她似乎并不这么想，因为她显然已经从海滩消失了，也不回我的短信。

lines.en: Two — Chika had sex with someone {i}else.{/i} Someone I am on the way to meet now.
lines.zh: 二——Chika 跟{i}别人{/i}上床了。而我现在正要去见的，就是那个人。

lines.en: Someone who, despite how things have been between us lately, has elected not to tell me either.
lines.zh: 一个尽管我们最近关系如此、却同样选择对我只字不提的人。

lines.en: {size=-4}So I am currently spiraling and thinking about whether or not this has happened with anyone {i}else{/i} just to be kept from me in favor of prolonging what is believed to be some sort of mental stability on my end when it’s really anything but.{/size}
lines.zh: {size=-4}所以我现在正在螺旋下坠，想着这种事是不是也在{i}别人{/i}身上发生过，只是为了不让我知道，好维持他们眼中我精神上的某种稳定——而事实恰恰相反。{/size}

lines.en: Shocking, I know. But when the grip on your manhood isn’t even strong enough to make you cum, it’s easy to to find yourself in the cuck chair every once in a while. And it’s easy to feel weak because of that.
lines.zh: 我知道，很震惊。可当握着你那话儿的手连让你射出来都不够有力时，你偶尔就很容易坐上那张绿帽椅。而且很容易因此觉得自己软弱。

lines.en: Which isn’t to say I’ve ever believed I’m {i}strong.{/i}
lines.zh: 我并不是说我曾以为自己有多{i}强大{/i}。

lines.en: It’s just been a long time since this has happened to me.
lines.zh: 只是我已经很久没有遇到这种事了。

lines.en: And based on what I’m thinking right now, I realize I have not grown at all.
lines.zh: 而根据我现在所想的，我意识到自己一点都没有长进。

lines.en: Let the record show that I blame no one but myself, though. Which would likely be true even if I had done nothing wrong.
lines.zh: 不过在此声明：我只怪我自己。就算我什么都没做错，大概也会是这样。

lines.en: But Chika is still Chika and Rin is still Rin and assuming they will love me and only me just because this universe has been abundantly convenient so far would be foolish. Especially when Rin has already shown me that.
lines.zh: 但 Chika 终究是 Chika，Rin 终究是 Rin，仅仅因为这个宇宙到目前为止一直格外方便，就假定她们会爱我、且只爱我，那就太蠢了。尤其 Rin 早就向我证明过这一点。

lines.en: I can lose all of them. At any moment. And that’s terrifying, but it isn’t enough to make me change my ways since this path was decided for me.
lines.zh: 我随时可能失去她们所有人。这很可怕，却还不足以让我改变自己的行事方式，因为这条路是替我决定好的。

lines.en: And if others elect to stop following me down it, well...
lines.zh: 而如果别人选择不再跟着我走下去，那么……

lines.en: Good for them, I guess.
lines.zh: 那就随他们吧，我想。

lines.en: scene rinbeachdate1
When I find Rin, she’s unmoving — staring off into the distance, watching little waves make first contact with the shoreline.
lines.zh: 我找到 Rin 的时候，她一动不动——望着远方，看着细小的浪花第一次触碰海岸线。

lines.en: {size=-4}I see the nape of her neck. Piercings I often forget are there. Discern the color of the band that keeps her ponytail in place. And I realize again just how beautiful the sides of people we don’t normally see can be when they’re finally presented to us.{/size}
lines.zh: {size=-4}我看见她的后颈。那些我常常忘了它们存在的耳钉。辨认出扎住她马尾的发圈颜色。而我再次意识到，当我们平时看不见的人的那些侧面终于呈现在我们眼前时，竟可以如此美丽。{/size}

lines.en: Yet I wonder what I look like from behind. And how boring that image must be for the ones I love to look elsewhere instead.
lines.zh: 可我不禁好奇，自己从背后看起来是什么样子。而那个画面该有多无聊，才会让我爱的人纷纷把目光投向别处。

lines.en: I remain here for a moment. Feet planted in the sand, half-swallowed by the earth.
lines.zh: 我在这里停留了片刻。双脚踩在沙里，被大地吞掉一半。

lines.en: : Sensei...
lines.zh: : Sensei……

lines.en: But my presence is noticed before I have the chance to destroy anything else.
lines.zh: 但在我毁掉别的东西之前，我的存在就被察觉了。

lines.en: : I don’t know if I want to do this anymore.
lines.zh: : 我不知道自己还想不想继续这样了。

lines.en: : I don’t know if I want to do {i}anything{/i} anymore.
lines.zh: : 我不知道自己还想不想做{i}任何事{/i}了。

lines.en: : Just, sometimes I...
lines.zh: : 只是，有时候我……

lines.en: : I can’t help but wonder how things would be if we never met.
lines.zh: : 我忍不住会想，如果我们从未相遇，一切会是什么样子。

lines.en: : If I was just Rin and you were just you and...
lines.zh: : 如果我只是 Rin，你只是你，然后……

lines.en: : And we existed in different parts of the world. Forever kept apart by fate itself.
lines.zh: : 然后我们存在于世界的不同角落。被命运本身永远隔开。

lines.en: scene rinbeachdate2
: Just kidding. I still want to hang out all day. It just felt weird to stand here without all of the drama and-
lines.zh: : 开玩笑的。我还是想跟你玩一整天。只是站在这儿却不带一点戏码，感觉怪怪的，所以——

lines.en: scene rinbeachdate3
: Oh no. Did that actually upset you? You look so sad. I’m sorry, I-
lines.zh: : 哦不。那真的让你难过了吗？你看起来好伤心。对不起，我——

lines.en: : No, it’s nothing. You’re fine.
lines.zh: : 不，没什么。你没事。

lines.en: scene rinbeachdate4
: {i}I’m fine.{/i} And I’m all yours for the entire day, so choose how you’d like to spend this time wisely.
lines.zh: : {i}我没事。{/i}而且我一整天都是你的，所以请明智地选择怎么打发这段时间。

lines.en: : Are you absolutely sure?
lines.zh: : 你确定吗？

lines.en: : I am absolutely sure.
lines.zh: : 我确定。

lines.en: : So is this frown because you finally banged Miss Watabe then and can’t find her anywhere?
lines.zh: : 那你这副愁眉苦脸，是因为终于跟 Watabe 小姐上床了、却到处找不到她？

lines.en: scene rinbeachdate5
: How do you already know about that?
lines.zh: : 你怎么已经知道了？

lines.en: : I didn’t, technically. But I saw her get on the bus this morning and heard some pretty damning noises coming from her room last night when I went to go for a walk. Guess I have proof now, though.
lines.zh: : 严格来说我不知道。不过我今天早上看见她上了巴士，昨晚我出去散步的时候，还听见她房间里传来一些相当要命的声音。不过现在看来，我有证据了。

lines.en: : Don’t tell anyone else, okay? I’m pretty sure she regrets it.
lines.zh: : 别告诉别人，好吗？我挺确定她后悔了。

lines.en: : I doubt that. Pretty much everybody knows about the tension between you guys. I just regret not being there to watch.
lines.zh: : 我可不这么想。你们之间那点紧张气氛，基本上人尽皆知。我只是后悔没能在场亲眼看看。

lines.en: scene rinbeachdate6
: Well, Wakana aside, what’s the plan? I assume you came up with one since this was your idea?
lines.zh: : 好吧，先不说 Wakana，计划是什么？既然这是你提的，我猜你已经想好了？

lines.en: : I {i}did!{/i} But it involves us leaving, so please follow me to the parking lot and get into the Uber that I am probably going to have to pay extra for since you were late.
lines.zh: : {i}当然！{/i}不过得先离开这儿，所以请跟我去停车场，上那辆我大概要因为你迟到而多付钱的优步。

lines.en: scene rinbeachdate7
: We’re leaving? Won’t that seem suspicious to everyone else when they can’t find either one of us?
lines.zh: : 我们要走？等她们谁都找不到我们俩，不会觉得很可疑吗？

lines.en: : I’ve got that under control too. Futaba and Ami are going to keep Imani distracted so she can’t go looking for you.
lines.zh: : 那点我也安排好了。Futaba 和 Ami 会负责拖住 Imani，让她没法去找你。

lines.en: : What about your mom?
lines.zh: : 那你妈妈呢？

lines.en: : She’ll probably get distracted by all of the seashells scattered around here or something. That one’s easy.
lines.zh: : 她大概会被这儿散落的贝壳什么的吸引走。那个好解决。

lines.en: : Well, where are we going then?
lines.zh: : 那我们到底要去哪儿？

lines.en: : Somewhere I can murder you and dispose of the body without issue. Duh.
lines.zh: : 去一个我能毫无后顾之忧地杀了你、处理掉尸体的地方。废话。

lines.en: : Oh. Well, I guess I should just follow you to the parking lot then, huh?
lines.zh: : 哦。那我想我就该乖乖跟您去停车场了，是吧？

lines.en: : Any last words you’d like to leave your niece-daughter and your hot idol girlfriend? I can relay them once I finish cleaning all of the blood off of me.
lines.zh: : 有什么遗言要留给你的侄女女儿和你那个火辣的偶像女朋友吗？等我把身上的血洗干净，可以替你转达。

lines.en: : No. But you can tell Noriko to apologize to both of them on my behalf since she’s better with words than I am.
lines.zh: : 没有。不过你可以让 Noriko 替我向她们俩道歉，因为她比我更会说漂亮话。

lines.en: : I’ll do my best to not forget while I’m dismembering you in a few hours.
lines.zh: : 几小时后把你大卸八块的时候，我尽量不忘。

lines.en: : Thanks, Rin. I appreciate that.
lines.zh: : 谢了，Rin。我很感激。

lines.en: : No worries, homie. I’m getting a new skull for my shelf out of it, so that’s more than enough for me.
lines.zh: : 不客气，老铁。反正我能给架子上添个新头骨，对我来说这就够本了。

lines.en: scene sky
And so the two of us get into a car together that takes us down a long winding road until I am thrown from the backseat and tied up while unconscious.
lines.zh: 于是我们俩上了一辆车，沿着一条漫长蜿蜒的路开了下去，直到我从后座被甩出去，在昏迷中被人捆了起来。

lines.en: When I awake, both of my legs are gone and Rin is in the process of removing my right arm.
lines.zh: 我醒来时，两条腿都没了，而 Rin 正在卸我的右臂。

lines.en: She tells me it has always been her favorite and I’m inclined to agree on account of it being my dominant one.
lines.zh: 她说那一直是她最喜欢的一条，我也倾向于同意，因为那正是我的惯用手。

lines.en: Regardless, I wish the arm goodbye and, within the hour, I have no limbs left to hurt anyone with.
lines.zh: 无论如何，我跟那条手臂道了别，不到一小时，我就再没有任何肢体能去伤害别人了。

lines.en: Of course none of this actually happens and what we {i}actually{/i} wind up doing is spending the day at a nearby outlet mall that apparently just opened.
lines.zh: 当然，这些其实都没发生，我们{i}真正{/i}去做的，是在附近一家刚开业的奥特莱斯逛了一天。

lines.en: Rin says it’s an extension of the one we have closer to the school, just she words it in a way that makes it sound more like that mall is growing than anything else.
lines.zh: Rin 说它是离学校更近那家的延伸，只是她的措辞听起来更像是那家商场在长大，而不是别的什么。

lines.en: And you’re not there.
lines.zh: 而你不在场。

lines.en: I left you behind because A) I didn’t want you to violate my corpse. And B) In the event that I was not murdered, it felt only right to award her the privacy she’s earned for waiting so long.
lines.zh: 我把你留在外面，因为 A）我不想让你亵渎我的尸体。B）万一我没被谋杀，我觉得也该把她等了这么久应得的隐私奖赏给她。

lines.en: scene noonsky

But this is privacy I will strip now as we’ve returned to the Place Where We Are Watched and I think {i}you{/i} have earned the right to see her naked teenage body after jerking off to it for so long.
lines.zh: 不过这份隐私我现在要剥掉了，因为我们回到了「被注视之地」，而我觉得{i}你{/i}都对她赤裸的未成年身体打了这么久的飞机，也该有权利看一看了。

lines.en: scene rinbeachdate8
: I like your towel. But I think it would look better on the floor.
lines.zh: : 我喜欢你的浴巾。不过我觉得它掉在地上会更好看。

lines.en: : The sauna is certainly an interesting choice to round out our day of off-screen fun.
lines.zh: : 用桑拿房来收尾我们这一天的镜头外娱乐，倒真是个有趣的选择。

lines.en: : Why do you shield your penis from me when I would very much like to see it with my own mouth? I mean hand. I mean eyes.
lines.zh: : 你干嘛要把鸡巴挡起来？我明明很想用自己的嘴看它——我是说用手。我是说用眼睛。

lines.en: : Rin, why are we here?
lines.zh: : Rin，我们为什么在这儿？

lines.en: : What do you mean why are we here?
lines.zh: : 你什么意思，为什么在这儿？

lines.en: : I mean that I am going to get ideas if you take me somewhere like this at the end of a date.
lines.zh: : 我的意思是，在约会的结尾把我带到这种地方，我会想入非非的。

lines.en: scene rinbeachdate9
: Oh. Well, yeah. That’s kind of the point.
lines.zh: : 哦。嗯，对啊。那不就是目的嘛。

lines.en: : I couldn’t think of anywhere more private at the inn and it would take too long for us to go back to the dorms together.
lines.zh: : 我在旅馆里想不出比这儿更私密的地方了，而且我们俩一起回宿舍又太花时间。

lines.en: : And honestly, I didn’t even realize this place {i}had{/i} a sauna until Ami told me about it earlier. So we can call it exploration and curiosity in more ways than just the fact that I want to see your penis.
lines.zh: : 说实话，我也是听 Ami 刚才提起，才知道这地方{i}还有{/i}桑拿房。所以除了我想看你的鸡巴之外，我们还能把这称为探索和好奇。

lines.en: : Are you telling me that we are only on the verge of crossing a line right now because of my daughter’s intervention?
lines.zh: : 你是说，我们现在之所以濒临越界，全都是因为我女儿的插手？

lines.en: : That and the fact that we’ve both been masturbating to each other for years now, yeah.
lines.zh: : 这个，再加上我们已经对着彼此打了几年飞机，对。

lines.en: : You’re coming on really strong today, I’m not gonna lie.
lines.zh: : 你今天攻势真的很猛，说真的。

lines.en: scene rinbeachdate10
: I’ve got the most dating experience out of anybody we know now. What can I say?
lines.zh: : 现在在场所有人里，我的恋爱经验最丰富了。我能说什么呢？

lines.en: : Yeah...you really do, don’t you?
lines.zh: : 是啊……你还真是，不是吗？

lines.en: scene rinbeachdate11
: Let’s sit down.
lines.zh: : 我们坐下吧。

lines.en: : If something happens, something happens. And if {i}nothing{/i} happens, I still had a great day. And it wouldn’t have even been half as great without you, Sensei.
lines.zh: : 如果发生点什么，那就发生吧。如果{i}什么{/i}都没发生，我今天依然过得很棒。而且如果没有你，这连一半的快乐都不会有，Sensei。

lines.en: : Probably because I would have been wandering around some unfamiliar outlet mall by myself. Then sitting alone in a sauna.
lines.zh: : 大概因为我本来会一个人在陌生的奥特莱斯里乱逛，然后一个人坐在桑拿房里。

lines.en: scene rinbeachdate12
: Huh. I wonder if this is how Yumi always feels?
lines.zh: : 嗯。我在想，Yumi 是不是一直都是这种感觉？

lines.en: scene rinbeachdate13
: So! Give me your review. How would you rate my performance as a girlfriend today?
lines.zh: : 那么！给我你的评价。今天我作为女友的表现，你打几分？

lines.en: : Surprisingly natural given how nervous you always are when it comes to romance.
lines.zh: : 考虑到你在恋爱这件事上总是紧张得要命，倒是出乎意料地自然。

lines.en: : I was thinking of more on a scale of one to ten, but I guess that works as well. It all {i}felt{/i} natural too. I like not having to change for you.
lines.zh: : 我想的是一到十的评分，不过这样也行吧。我也{i}觉得{/i}一切都挺自然的。我喜欢不用为你改变自己。

lines.en: : Well, that’s good. Because I think changing at all would just make you less likable in the end.
lines.zh: : 嗯，那很好。因为我觉得你只要有一点改变，最终都只会让你更不讨人喜欢。

lines.en: scene rinbeachdate14

: Oh? Are you implying I am {i}perfect{/i} then? Shall we tell the rest of the class to hang it up and that I have been crowned the winner despite being one of the few girls you have yet to {i}breach?{/i}
lines.zh: : 哦？那你是在暗示我很{i}完美{/i}咯？要不要我们去告诉全班其他人放弃吧，就说尽管我是你还没{i}攻破{/i}的少数几个女孩之一，却已经加冕为冠军了？

lines.en: : Well, if nothing else, you’re certainly the first to refer to losing your virginity as being {i}breached.{/i}
lines.zh: : 嗯，别的先不说，你绝对是第一个把失去童贞说成{i}「被攻破」{/i}的人。

lines.en: scene rinbeachdate15
: My hetero virginity at least. Otoha and I went through a pretty intense honeymoon phase as I’m sure you’ve heard. Like, literally. Through a wall.
lines.zh: : 至少我的异性童贞是这样。我和 Otoha 经历过一段相当激烈的蜜月期，你肯定听说过。就是，字面意义上的。隔着墙。

lines.en: : {i}Just{/i} Otoha?
lines.zh: : {i}只有{/i} Otoha？

lines.en: scene rinbeachdate16
: Huh?
: Was it really {i}just{/i} Otoha you did those things with, Rin?
lines.zh: : 你真的{i}只{/i}跟 Otoha 做过那些事吗，Rin？

lines.en: : What do you mean? Of course it was just her. Who else have I dated?
lines.zh: : 什么意思？当然只有她啊。我还跟谁交往过？

lines.en: : Forget it. It’s nothing.
lines.zh: : 算了。没什么。

lines.en: : Sensei, what’s going on? Why are you acting so sketchy all of a-
lines.zh: : Sensei，怎么了？你为什么突然这么可疑——

lines.en: : Why are you lying to me?
lines.zh: : 你为什么要骗我？

lines.en: scene rinbeachdate17
: I’m not! Why do you think I’m-
lines.zh: : 我没有！你凭什么觉得我——

lines.en: : Rin, do you know why I was late today?
lines.zh: : Rin，你知道我今天为什么迟到吗？

lines.en: : Yes! Because you were banging Miss Watabe!
lines.zh: : 知道啊！因为你在跟 Watabe 小姐上床！

lines.en: : Because I was talking to Chika.
lines.zh: : 因为我在跟 Chika 说话。

lines.en: scene rinbeachdate18
: Yeah.
: And.......what did Chika tell you, exactly?
lines.zh: : 那……Chika 到底跟你说了些什么？

lines.en: : Enough for me to know you’re lying right now.
lines.zh: : 多到足够让我知道，你现在在撒谎。

lines.en: scene rinbeachdate19
: Yeah, I...
lines.zh: : 是啊，我……

lines.en: : That was a lie.
lines.zh: : 那是谎话。

lines.en: scene rinbeachdate20

: It’s not how it sounds, though! Like that was just {i}one{/i} time and it came out of literally nowhere and I had no idea what was even going {i}on{/i} at the time! Like, it doesn’t even count to me. Not at all.
lines.zh: : 不过不是你想的那样！就那{i}一次{/i}，而且完全是凭空冒出来的，当时我根本不知道{i}发生了什么{/i}！对我来说那根本不算数。完全不算。

lines.en: scene rinbeachdate21
: How long did you have a crush on her for, Rin?
lines.zh: : 你暗恋她多久了，Rin？

lines.en: : What does that-
lines.zh: : 这跟——

lines.en: : Longer than you’ve had one on me. Right?
lines.zh: : 比暗恋我的时间还久。对吧？

lines.en: : {i}Maybe,{/i} yeah! But I don’t get why everyone keeps asking me that when-
lines.zh: : {i}也许是吧！{/i}可我不明白为什么大家一直问我这个，明明——

lines.en: : Rin, you’re only saying that Chika doesn’t count because the two of you are in a weird spot and you’ve moved on to focusing on {i}me{/i} instead of her. That’s it.
lines.zh: : Rin，你说 Chika 不算数，只是因为你们俩现在关系很怪，而你转而把注意力放在{i}我{/i}身上了。就只是这样。

lines.en: : Because {i}you’re{/i} the one I like!
